annotations.title: Create a TikTok custom ad identity

description: Create a TikTok CUSTOM IDENTITY (CUSTOMIZED_USER) on the brand's TikTok ad account: the name and avatar a non-Spark ad shows. displayName (1 to 40 characters) and avatarUrl (a public https square image; upload_file makes one) are required; advertiserId defaults to the brand's ad account. TikTok is retiring custom-identity ads: new ad accounts cannot run them, and ad groups delivering on TikTok placements refuse them, so Spark Ads (a real TikTok account, list_tiktok_ads_identities) is the path for most ads. Read back from TikTok. Free.
name: create_tiktok_ads_identity
title: Create a TikTok custom ad identity
